name: Chantilly

vendor.company: online-ml ("The Fellowship of Online Machine Learning"), primary author Max Halford (maxhalford25@gmail.com)
vendor.hq: UNKNOWN (community/individual project; Max Halford is France-based)
vendor.scale: ~98 stars; niche. Part of the River (formerly creme) ecosystem. License BSD-3.

dorks: http.html:"You need to select a flavor"

verification_primitive.probe: GET http://<host>:5000/api/init (read-only). Optionally GET /api/models to enumerate deployed model names. Both are pure GETs, no state change.
verification_primitive.success_signal: HTTP 200 with JSON body containing the keys flavor, storage, and river_version (or a JSON error {"message":...} from the FlavorNotSet handler, which still confirms chantilly is the running app). /api/models returns {"models":[...],"default":...}.
verification_primitive.impact_when_open: Confirms an unauthenticated chantilly instance, leaks storage backend (shelve/redis) and River version. Establishes — without any write — that the unauth POST /api/model dill.loads() RCE primitive is reachable, since the same blueprint has zero auth before_request. Restraint: confirm with the GET; do not send the dill RCE payload.

endpoints.returns: Chantilly dashboard SPA. HTML <title>Chantilly</title>, Vue app, link to github.com/creme-ml/chantilly, flavor header. Reveals instance is live and unauthenticated.

JSON {flavor, storage, river_version} — e.g. {"flavor":"regression","storage":"redis","river_version":"0.9.0"}. Leaks backend type and River version (CVE-scoping). Returns FlavorNotSet error if unconfigured. Best fingerprint + recon read.
JSON {models:[...names...], default:<name>} — enumerates all deployed model names (slug like 'earsplitting-apricot').
Raw dill bytes of the default model (full serialized River estimator) — model exfiltration, no auth.
Raw dill bytes of the named model.
Stores a model by running dill.loads(request.get_data()) on the raw body — UNAUTH ARBITRARY DESERIALIZATION = RCE. Returns {name}, 201.
Runs the stored model on attacker-supplied features, returns {model, prediction}. Stores features under #<id> if id provided. Inference abuse / model probing.
Updates the model and metrics with attacker-supplied ground truth — UNAUTH MODEL POISONING. Returns {},201.
Deletes a model (204) — unauth destructive write.
JSON of current metric values (e.g. {"MAE":1.23}). Leaks model performance and that the instance is active.
JSON predict/learn call counts and mean/EWM latencies — usage volume disclosure.
SSE text/event-stream of live metric updates.
SSE text/event-stream of live predict/learn events including the actual feature payloads flowing through the model — passive data interception.
